title: How to write SEO podcast episode titles on Mac: a guide for producers

description: Stop guessing your episode titles. Learn how to write SEO podcast episode titles on your Mac to grow your audience without the burnout.
intro: You can write SEO podcast episode titles on your Mac by focusing on user intent rather than just keywords. A strong title tells the listener exactly what they will gain from clicking play.

stats.label: Creators stuck on planning and scripting

blocks.text: Why writing SEO podcast episode titles feels hard

Most producers treat titles as an afterthought. You spend hours editing audio and then slap a generic title on the episode at the last second. This is a mistake. Search engines and listeners rely on that title to decide if your content is worth their time.

The problem often comes from a lack of structure. When you open Google Docs or your hosting dashboard, you stare at a blank screen. You try to be clever instead of being clear. Search engines do not reward clever. They reward clarity and relevance.

Poor titles lead to low click-through rates. If people do not click, they do not listen. This wastes the effort you put into the production. You end up spending more time on promotion later to make up for the lack of organic growth.
How to fix your title workflow without buying new tools

items: Research search terms in Chrome before you record.
Focus on the primary benefit for the listener.
Keep your titles consistent in format.
Use your Mac Notes app to store a list of high-performing title structures.

blocks.text: Using your Mac to speed up the process

Your Mac is a powerful tool for this. Use Safari or Chrome to search for similar shows. Look at what they use in their titles. Do not copy them, but identify the patterns. Are they using numbers? Are they asking questions?
Always check your employer's guidelines if you are producing for a corporate client. They may have strict rules on how you represent their brand in public titles.
blocks.title: A note on compliance

faq.question: How long should a podcast title be?
faq.answer: Keep it under 60 characters so it displays fully in podcast apps like Apple Podcasts.

faq.question: Should I put the guest name in the title?
faq.answer: Only if the guest is well-known. If the guest is not famous, focus on the topic or the problem you solve.

costs.title: Burnout

causes.title: Lack of process

causes.title: Focusing on the wrong metrics
causes.text: Prioritizing cleverness over search intent makes your titles invisible to algorithms.

fixes.title: Create a title template
fixes.text: Develop 3 standard structures that work for your show and rotate them.

fixes.title: Use your transcript
fixes.text: Pull the most interesting quote from your transcript and use it as a title base.
